statement: Help an anonymous pet parent browse the captured ASPCA Pet Health Insurance marketing surfaces, obtain and customize a deterministic dog or cat quote, resume it by synthetic email and ZIP, and complete a clone-local enrollment using an explicit local-sandbox payment outcome. An approval atomically creates one policy snapshot and one local policy-confirmation outbox job; no card, bank, provider credential, real email, or external charge is accepted or sent. The public portal login, registration, and password-reset shells continue to fail closed until authenticated source evidence is captured.

actor_scope.notes: Anonymous pet parent browsing marketing pages and starting the quote funnel. The anonymous source surfaces were captured directly under the configured remote-browser channel.

Visitor with an in-progress quote for the frozen synthetic cat scenario. Source evidence reaches checkout entry and stops before any payment field. The candidate adds a clearly labeled local-sandbox continuation whose amount and immutable payment facts are computed only by the server.

The public login, register, and forgot-password shells are captured. Authenticated member pages were not accessible without the optional read-only credential handoff, so the clone fails closed and performs no member mutation.

simulations: sim.rating-table: quote prices come from a local table for the captured scenario and supported plan controls; observed rows retain observed provenance and derived cells retain derived provenance.
sim.local-payment: checkout accepts only an opaque approved, declined, or retryable scenario ID; all amounts and immutable facts are server-derived and no provider is contacted.
sim.local-enrollment: an approved local payment is consumed atomically with the enrollment snapshot and a policy-confirmation LOCAL_SIMULATION outbox job.
sim.recaptcha-pass-through: the source funnel's remote reCAPTCHA dependency is replaced with a deterministic same-origin pass-through with no external request.
out_of_scope: Persistent member accounts, authenticated sessions, member dashboard, policy documents, claims, billing, autopay, policy updates, cancellations, and renewals until authenticated source evidence is supplied.
Password recovery and member account registration; portal submissions fail closed and create no authentication mail. The only mail purpose is the clone-local policy confirmation.

Real email delivery, Stripe test/live processing, card, CVC, expiry, bank, wallet, token, refund, chargeback, autopay, or provider webhook behavior. STRIPE_TEST_AUTHORIZED=false and LIVE_PAYMENT_AUTHORIZED=false.
Horse insurance quoting, employee-benefits surfaces, and the editorial long tail outside the frozen route matrix.
Live third-party widgets, consent managers, A/B testing, analytics, advertising, and any runtime request outside the clone origin.
Any mutation of a real ASPCA member account or use of real personally identifiable information.

release_authority.note: Diagnostics are diagnostic-only. Nothing in this contract constitutes acceptance, rights, push, PR, deployment, payment, email, or publication authority. This run's ceiling is check-only and dry-run; PUSH_AUTHORIZED=false, PR_AUTHORIZED=false, PUBLIC_DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZED=false.

time_semantics.note: Quote, selection, enrollment, and migration timestamps derive from this frozen clock.
